old_caption: The video captures a serene beach scene at sunset. The sun is positioned low on the horizon, casting a warm golden glow across the sky and reflecting off the calm ocean surface. The waves gently lap against the shore. On the right side of the frame, a cliff rises steeply, silhouetted against the backdrop of the setting sun. Atop the cliff, buildings are visible. The sky is partly cloudy. The overall mood is peaceful and contemplative. There are no animals or characters present. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene beach scene at sunset. The sun is positioned low on the horizon, casting a warm golden glow across the sky and reflecting off the calm ocean surface. The waves gently lap against the shore, creating a soothing sound that complements the tranquil atmosphere. On the right side of the frame, a cliff rises steeply, silhouetted against the vibrant backdrop of the setting sun. Atop the cliff, a few buildings are visible, adding a touch of human presence to the otherwise natural landscape. The sky is partly cloudy, with streaks of light breaking through the darker clouds, enhancing the dramatic effect of the sunset. The overall mood of the video is peaceful and contemplative, inviting viewers to appreciate the beauty of nature. There are no animals or characters present in the video; it focuses solely on the natural elements and the interplay of light and shadow during the sunset. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing the viewer to fully absorb the tranquil beauty of the scene
caption: The video captures a coastal beach scene at a low sun, with the bright disc sitting just above a flat horizon beneath a thick overcast sky. A vertical glitter path of reflected light stretches across the otherwise calm sea toward the shore. On the right, a dark headland rises steeply, topped by a pale multi-windowed building whose light walls stand out against the dim sky. The framing of the sun, cliff, building and horizon stays largely steady, consistent with a fixed camera. The main visible motion is the gentle wave action along the lower foreground, where a thin line of foam marks the waterline on the right side. This foam edge shifts slightly back and forth in a small swash oscillation, its width and shape changing from frame to frame. A small dark object resting near the foam line early on stays in place but grows less distinct as the waterline moves and the foam band narrows toward the right edge. Meanwhile, the reflection column on the water continuously ripples and the open-sea surface shows subtle ongoing motion.

An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
